Bill.BriefDescription: Excluding federal income tax payments from the financial eligibility requirements for long-term care services under the community options program entry system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to excluding federal income tax payments from theresource eligibility requirements of the community options programentry system; and adding a new section to chapter 74.39 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In determining the maximum amount of resources a person can have tomeet the resource eligibility requirements for community optionsprogram entry system benefits or services, the department may notinclude amounts paid by the person, or the person's spouse, for federalincome taxes.
